basic_info.description: Located in the historic Arthur Conan Doyle building. Welcome to 2151 Sacramento Street, Unit 2, an elegant 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo nestled in San Francisco's coveted Pacific Heights neighborhood. Built in 1920, this 812-square-foot residence seamlessly blends historic character with modern comforts. The unit features an open floor plan, tall ceilings, hardwood floors, and large windows that flood the space with natural light. The remodeled kitchen is equipped with premium Viking stove and Samsung fridge, catering to culinary enthusiasts. Additional highlights include a private deck, ample storage, and in-unit laundry facilities. Situated directly across from Lafayette Park and a short walk from the vibrant shops and cafes on Fillmore Street, this condo offers the quintessential San Francisco urban living experience. Don't miss the opportunity to own this Pacific Heights gem!
